howto.what: Claude会询问你要处理的功能名称和要运行的阶段范围，然后检查已有文档，依次调用对应的技能（brief、spec等），完成后总结产出和下一步建议。
howto.when: 当你想要启动从brief到draft PR的标准交付流程，或要求运行特定阶段时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude will ask for the feature name and the stage range (e.g., full, spec->code, or resume). Then it checks existing artifacts in docs/briefs, docs/specs, docs/qa/reports. For each selected stage, it invokes the corresponding skill and summarizes the output, changes, decisions, and next step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to start a standard delivery workflow from brief to draft PR, run a partial stage sequence, or resume from existing work.

say_en.text: Create a full workflow from brief to draft PR for a new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the feature name and stage range.
